market_question: Will Ivan Cepeda Castro win the 2026 Colombian presidential election?
reasoning: Ivan Cepeda is a prominent figure within the left-wing Pacto Histórico but is not the official candidate and faces competition from other leftists. President Petro’s declining approval ratings and Colombia’s historical tendency to alternate power make a left victory in 2026 less likely, and Cepeda’s personal chances are therefore lower than the market implies.
evidence_points: Cepeda has not been nominated; the coalition could choose Vice President Francia Márquez or another figure.
Petro’s falling approval (often below 40%) reduces the left’s electoral prospects.
No party has won two consecutive Colombian presidential elections in recent decades.
sources_consulted: Recent opinion polls on Petro’s government (as of early 2025)
